Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A snapshot of your dayAs a Data Engineer in Finance, you build and run the data foundations and products that Siemens Energy Finance uses for reporting, analytics, automation and AI. Our team covers the whole landscape: platform and product delivery, from source systems to consumption. Depending on your strengths and our priorities, your focus can lean towards platform or delivery, source or consumption. You work closely with product owners, data architects, data governance and literacy specialists and Finance stakeholders. It is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who likes seeing their work used in production.How youll make an impactWork across the platform (shared ingestion, integration and engineering foundations) and data product delivery (turning Finance requirements into production-grade products).Cover the full data flow, from integrating ERP and other source systems via ETL/ELT to well-modelled data for reporting, analytics and AI.Build maintainable transformations and data models with Snowflake, SQL, Python and dbt.Embed data quality checks, testing, observability and lineage into everything you deliver.Use Git (e.g. GitLab, GitHub) and CI/CD for controlled, repeatable deployments.Own your work end to end, from design to production operation, and fix recurring failures at their root cause.Align with product owners on scope and priorities, and share knowledge through documentation, reusable code and coaching.What you bring5+ years in data engineering, building and operating production pipelines, platforms or data products.Strong hands-on skills in Snowflake, advanced SQL, Python and dbt.Practical experience with Git (e.g. GitLab, GitHub, Azure DevOps), CI/CD and automated testing.Sound knowledge of data modelling, database design and performance optimization.Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions and to fix production issues.A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or a relevant apprenticeship.Nice to have: knowledge of Finance data and processes, semantic modelling, and practical AI skills (e.g. working with LLMs or AI-assisted development).A results-driven, collaborative mindset for a complex, international environment.Strong professional English; German is a plus.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but were also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur OfficeSiemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is more than just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and growing community. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.Our Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character ??? no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
